title: Heavy Industry
purpose: Grow the workshop into a large steel, fuel, freight, power, and defense installation.
optimization_opportunities: Run steel and fuel continuously, reuse power/logistics trunks, and move bulk goods without inventories carried by hand.
infrastructure_reuse: Existing ore processing, storage, Quarry output, and routing feed every heavy-industry line.

milestones.title: Automated Railcraft Steel
final_validation: Produce Railcraft steel in a repeatable industrial process.

milestones.title: Oil Refining and Fluid Storage
final_validation: Refine oil and buffer fuel at industrial scale.

milestones.title: Advanced IC2 Processing
final_validation: Operate advanced IC2 machines on an appropriately transformed network.

milestones.title: Industrial Freight
final_validation: Move bulk materials or fuel using rail or an equivalent logistics trunk.

milestones.title: Industrial Armament
final_validation: Manufacture a firearm and ammunition through the factory.

milestones.title: Human Factions
final_validation: Trade with a friendly settlement, survive a hostile encounter, and approach an ambiguous armed faction.

milestones.title: Industrial Containment
final_validation: Build an MFFS defensive, restricted-area, or containment installation.

milestones.title: Heavy Industrial Complex
final_validation: Sustain steel, refined fuel, advanced processing, powered storage, and bulk logistics.

milestones.title: Industrial Capacity Secured
milestones.capability: Gain heavy industrial capacity by building it or restoring a captured abandoned factory.
final_validation: Complete the Heavy Industrial Complex construction route OR restore the side-path abandoned factory to safe operation.
milestones.temporary_validation: Check this transition after either prerequisite route completes. The restored-factory route intentionally bypasses Chapter 4 construction quests.
